overall_assessment: High closure finding: real Meta authorization and real device pairing plus per-modality IN/OUT remain unproved, so ST-CON-01 cannot close overall. Locally, the cutover is structurally canonical: durable immutable provider identity, per-channel encrypted credentials, scoped BFF/public/Typebot resolution, and retired legacy routes leave no observed global-token fallback, dual-read/write bridge, or query-time stitching. The exact credentialless migrated-official reauthorization exception is bounded to the same BU/channel/phone and promotes lifecycle trust only after fresh proof; unmanaged Evolution remains rejected. The WSLENV change is an authorized non-secret operator configuration bridge, not a credential or runtime fallback.
recommended_path: Accept the local cutover architecture as ready for controlled external validation, while keeping the TODO active and making no completion or production claim. Perform the redacted real-provider protocol for Meta authorization/selected-number/receipt and device QR/own-number proof, then demonstrate real IN and OUT for both modalities and complete the remaining required consolidation gates. Do not add a legacy token, fallback credential source, or parallel route to bridge those proofs.

findings.title: Required real-provider and device evidence is still absent for overall TODO closure
findings.rationale: The bounded evidence proves local configuration, synthetic callback/header behavior, isolated runtime wiring, and local test behavior, but not an actual Meta Embedded Signup authorization and selected-number lifecycle, actual device QR pairing with own-number confirmation, or real inbound and outbound delivery for both modalities. The governing TODO explicitly remains Pending and requires real proofs; provider doubles and synthetic probes cannot substitute for them. This blocks overall closeout, not the local canonical-cutover conclusion.
findings.suggested_action: Keep the TODO active; use authorized test resources and the temporary HTTPS origin to capture redacted, per-channel evidence for authorization/pairing, identity confirmation, first IN, and OUT receipt. Then submit those results to the remaining required closeout and consolidation gates.
